name: Sysinfocus simple/ui
summary: Blazor component library inspired by shadcn/ui, with 70+ components and a live example page for each.
description: A Razor component library for Blazor, inspired by the shadcn/ui components. The docs site lists 70+ components — accordion, data table, AI chat, file manager, maps, scheduler and more — each with an example page. The project is MIT-licensed open source, ships free UI templates, and has moved to a new home at BLAZOR.ART.
contains: 70+ Blazor components, each with an example page
